name: Life & Death
q: Better to roll in mud alive than dead
A dead minister is worse off than a live dog
Life is short, death is long
Even the afterlife road needs travel money
To fear death is to claim knowledge we lack
Think of death as ordinary as a day passing
To philosophize is to learn to die
We are but dust and shadow
A life well used brings a happy death
Death stamps value on the coin of life
Life and death are like day and night
I to die, you to live; God knows which
Each of us carries his death within him, as a fruit carries its stone
The generations of men are as leaves
